title: The Proxy-Status HTTP Response Header Field

clauses.quote: HTTP accommodates these types of errors with a few status codes -- for example, 502 (Bad Gateway) and 504 (Gateway Timeout). However, experience has shown that more information is necessary to aid debugging and communicate what's happened to the client.
clauses.gateway: 背景：只靠 502、504 之类的状态码说不清出了什么事，这是 Proxy-Status 要解决的问题。客户端实际能不能看到入口响应里的头，由矩阵测。

clauses.quote: Note that in this specification, "proxy" is used to indicate both forward and reverse proxies, otherwise known as gateways. "Next hop" indicates the connection in the direction leading to the origin server for the request.
clauses.gateway: 本文的 next hop 是朝源站方向的下一段连接。对网关来说下一跳是上游代理，不是源站：按字面，connection_refused、connection_timeout 这些类型说的是网关到上游代理的连接；上游代理报告它连不上目标，不是同一回事，选错误类型时要分清。

clauses.quote: The Proxy-Status HTTP response field allows an intermediary to convey additional information about its handling of a response and its associated request.
clauses.gateway: Proxy-Status 是响应字段，由中间方填写。入口可以在自己生成的响应（407、403、502、503、504，以及 CONNECT 的响应）和转发的响应上用它说明处理情况。

clauses.quote: Its value is a List (see Section 3.1 of [STRUCTURED-FIELDS]). Each member of the List represents an intermediary that has handled the response. The first member represents the intermediary closest to the origin server, and the last member represents the intermediary closest to the user agent.
clauses.gateway: 值是结构化字段的 List，一个成员代表一个中间方，离源站最近的在最前。入口给已经带有 Proxy-Status 的响应加成员时，加在末尾。

clauses.quote: Intermediaries determine when it is appropriate to add the Proxy- Status field to a response.
clauses.gateway: 加不加 Proxy-Status 由中间方自己决定，条款不要求每个响应都加。

clauses.quote: Each member of the List identifies the intermediary that inserted the value and MUST have a type of either String or Token. Depending on the deployment, this might be a service name (but not a software or hardware product name; e.g., "ExampleCDN" is appropriate, but "ExampleProxy" is not because it doesn't identify the deployment), a hostname ("proxy-3.example.com"), an IP address, or a generated string.
clauses.gateway: 成员本身必须是 String 或 Token，用来标识这个部署。入口用的名字应当来自部署配置（服务名、主机名或生成的字符串），不能写死成软件的名字。

clauses.quote: While all of these parameters are OPTIONAL, intermediaries are encouraged to provide as much information as possible (but see Section 4 for security considerations in doing so).
clauses.gateway: 所有参数都是可选的；鼓励多给信息，但要先过第 4 节关于泄露信息的考虑。

clauses.quote: When adding a value to the Proxy-Status field, intermediaries SHOULD preserve the existing members of the field to allow debugging of the entire chain of intermediaries handling the request unless explicitly configured to remove them (e.g., to prevent internal network details from leaking; see Section 4).
clauses.gateway: 转发的响应里已经有 Proxy-Status（上游代理或更后面的中间方加的）时，入口应当保留原有成员，再追加自己的；除非明确配置成去掉。只有明文的转发会遇到这种情况，隧道里的响应入口看不到。保留下来的成员是上游自己说的，内容未经核实（见 9209-4-3）。

clauses.quote: Origin servers MUST NOT generate the Proxy-Status field.
clauses.gateway: 背景：约束的是源站。合规的源站不会生成这个字段，所以从上游方向收到的 Proxy-Status 应当都出自中间方；网关无法核实这一点。

clauses.quote: However, because it might be silently discarded along the path to the user agent (as is the case for all trailer fields; see Section 6.5 of [HTTP]), Proxy-Status SHOULD NOT be sent as a trailer field unless it is not possible to send it in the header section.
clauses.gateway: 能放在响应头里就不要放在 trailer 里。入口自己生成的错误响应都把 Proxy-Status 放在头里；只有响应头已经发出之后才出的错，才谈得上用 trailer，而且要满足 9209-2-10 的前提。

clauses.quote: Proxy-Status MAY be sent as an HTTP trailer field. For example, if an intermediary is streaming a response and the inbound connection suddenly terminates, Proxy-Status can only be appended to the trailer section of the outbound message since the header section has already been sent.
clauses.gateway: Proxy-Status 可以放在 trailer 里。原文举的例子正是网关会遇到的：流式转发响应的中途上游连接断了，响应头已经发出，只能写进 trailer。限制见 9209-2-8、9209-2-10。这两句在原文里排在 9209-2-8 之前。

clauses.quote: To allow recipients to reconstruct the relative ordering of Proxy- Status members conveyed in trailer fields with those conveyed in header fields, an intermediary MUST NOT send Proxy-Status as a trailer field unless it has also generated a Proxy-Status header field with the same member (although potentially different parameters) in that message.
clauses.gateway: 要在 trailer 里发 Proxy-Status，同一条消息的头里必须已经有网关自己生成的、成员相同的 Proxy-Status（参数可以不同）。入口如果打算在转发中途出错时用 trailer 报告，就得在每个可能用到 trailer 的转发响应的头里先放上自己的成员；头里没放过，事后就不能用 trailer。

clauses.quote: Unrecognised parameters MUST be ignored.
clauses.gateway: 约束的是读这个字段的一方。上游一侧：网关解析上游响应里的 Proxy-Status 时，不认识的参数必须忽略，不能当成错误。入口：客户端按同样的规则读入口发出的字段。

clauses.quote: The error parameter's value is a Token that is a proxy error type. When present, it indicates that the intermediary encountered an issue when obtaining this response.
clauses.gateway: error 参数的值是一个 Token（不带引号），取自错误类型表。入口在取不到响应时用它说明原因。

clauses.quote: The presence of some proxy error types indicates that the response was generated by the intermediary itself, rather than being forwarded from the origin server. This is the case when, for example, the origin server can't be contacted, so the proxy has to create its own response.
clauses.gateway: 有些错误类型本身就表明响应是中间方自己生成的，不是源站的。调用方可以据此区分“代理说的 502”和“源站说的 502”，前提是它看得到这个头。

clauses.quote: When sending the error parameter, the most specific proxy error type SHOULD be sent, provided that it accurately represents the error condition.
clauses.gateway: 入口发 error 时应当选最具体的类型，前提是它准确：拿不准具体原因时用泛指的类型，不要猜一个具体的。

clauses.quote: Each proxy error type has a recommended HTTP status code. When generating an HTTP response containing the error, its HTTP status code SHOULD be set to the recommended HTTP status code. However, there may be circumstances (e.g., for backwards compatibility with previous behaviours, a status code has already been sent) when another status code might be used.
clauses.gateway: 入口自己生成带 error 的响应时，状态码应当用该错误类型建议的那个（各类型的建议值见 2.3 节的条款）。原文留了例外，例如状态码已经发出去的时候。

clauses.quote: The next-hop parameter's value is a String or Token that identifies the intermediary or origin server selected (and used, if contacted) to obtain this response. It might be a hostname, IP address, or alias.
clauses.gateway: next-hop 标识这次选用的下一跳，对网关就是选中的上游代理。它可以是别名，不必是主机名或 IP；入口要用这个参数时用别名，免得把上游代理的地址告诉客户端（见 9209-4-1）。

clauses.quote: The received-status parameter's value indicates the HTTP status code that the intermediary received from the next-hop server when obtaining this response.
clauses.gateway: received-status 是中间方从下一跳收到的状态码。上游的 HTTP 代理对网关的请求或 CONNECT 回了错误状态时，入口可以用它把上游的原始状态码告诉调用方；上游是 SOCKS5 代理时没有 HTTP 状态码可填。

clauses.quote: The value MUST be an Integer.
clauses.gateway: 入口发 received-status 时，值必须是结构化字段的 Integer，例如 received-status=502，不加引号。

clauses.quote: The details parameter's value is a String containing additional information not captured anywhere else. This can include implementation-specific or deployment-specific information.
clauses.gateway: details 是自由文本的 String，可以放实现或部署特有的信息。入口可以用它放 error 表达不了的细节（例如上游 SOCKS5 的应答码）。放什么要按第 4 节权衡，原文没有禁止性的规定；不放上游地址之类的内部信息是网关自己的设计决定，要记进决策文档。

clauses.quote: Note that implementations might not produce all proxy error types. The set of types below is designed to map to existing states in implementations and therefore may not be applicable to some.
clauses.gateway: 背景：实现不必产生全部错误类型，入口只用与自己的状态对得上的那些。

clauses.quote: Name: dns_timeout Description: The intermediary encountered a timeout when trying to find an IP address for the next-hop hostname. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 504 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 网关自己解析下一跳（上游代理）的主机名超时时用，建议状态码 504。目标主机名交给上游去解析的情形，解析不是网关做的，不适用这一类型。

clauses.quote: Name: dns_error Description: The intermediary encountered a DNS error when trying to find an IP address for the next-hop hostname. Extra Parameters: rcode: A String conveying the DNS RCODE that indicates the error type. See [RFC8499], Section 3. info-code: An Integer conveying the Extended DNS Error Code INFO- CODE. See [RFC8914]. Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 网关自己解析下一跳的主机名出错时用，建议状态码 502，可带 rcode、info-code 两个附加参数。同样只适用于网关自己做的解析。

clauses.quote: Name: destination_unavailable Description: The intermediary considers the next hop to be unavailable; e.g., recent attempts to communicate with it may have failed, or a health check may indicate that it is down. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 503 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 网关认为下一跳不可用时用（例如最近的尝试都失败、健康检查判定它不可用），建议状态码 503。代理池里的上游都被判定不可用、不再去连时，符合这个描述。

clauses.quote: Name: destination_ip_prohibited Description: The intermediary is configured to prohibit connections to the next-hop IP address. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 按配置禁止连接下一跳的 IP 地址时用，建议状态码 502。按字面说的是下一跳的 IP；入口按策略拒绝请求本身时用 http_request_denied（见 9209-2.3.17-1）。

clauses.quote: Name: connection_refused Description: The intermediary's connection to the next hop was refused. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 网关到下一跳的连接被拒时用，建议状态码 502。按字面是网关连上游代理被拒；上游代理报告目标拒绝连接（例如 SOCKS5 应答码 X'05'）算不算这一类，条款没有说，要自己定并写明。

clauses.quote: Name: connection_terminated Description: The intermediary's connection to the next hop was closed before a complete response was received. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: false
clauses.gateway: 到下一跳的连接在收到完整响应之前被关掉时用，建议状态码 502；这一类型不只出现在中间方自己生成的响应里（false）。上游在握手或响应中途断开时适用。

clauses.quote: Name: connection_timeout Description: The intermediary's attempt to open a connection to the next hop timed out. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 504 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 网关向下一跳发起连接超时时用，建议状态码 504。

clauses.quote: Name: connection_read_timeout Description: The intermediary was expecting data on a connection (e.g., part of a response) but did not receive any new data in a configured time limit. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 504 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: false
clauses.gateway: 网关在连接上等数据、在配置的时限内没等到时用，建议状态码 504。例如连上了上游代理，但它迟迟不回 CONNECT 的响应或 SOCKS5 的应答。

clauses.quote: Name: connection_limit_reached Description: The intermediary is configured to limit the number of connections it has to the next hop, and that limit has been exceeded. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 503 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 网关按配置限制到下一跳的连接数、并且已经超限时用，建议状态码 503。

clauses.quote: Name: http_request_error Description: The intermediary is generating a client (4xx) response on the origin's behalf. Applicable status codes include (but are not limited to) 400, 403, 405, 406, 408, 411, 413, 414, 415, 416, 417, and 429. Extra Parameters: status-code: An Integer containing the generated status code. status-phrase: A String containing the generated status phrase. Recommended HTTP Status Code: The applicable 4xx status code Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 中间方代源站生成 4xx 响应时用，状态码就是那个 4xx，可带 status-code、status-phrase。入口因为请求本身有问题而回 400 之类时适用；按策略拒绝用下一条。

clauses.quote: Name: http_request_denied Description: The intermediary rejected the HTTP request based on its configuration and/or policy settings. The request wasn't forwarded to the next hop. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 403 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 入口按配置或策略拒绝请求、并且没有把请求转给下一跳时用，建议状态码 403。目标不在允许范围内、会话参数不被接受之类的拒绝适用。

clauses.quote: Name: http_response_incomplete Description: The intermediary received an incomplete response to the request from the next hop. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: false
clauses.gateway: 网关从下一跳收到的响应不完整时用，建议状态码 502；这一类型不只出现在中间方自己生成的响应里（false）。明文转发时上游的响应中途截断适用。它与 connection_terminated（9209-2.3.8-1）怎么分，原文没有说；按 9209-2.1.1-3 选更具体而且准确的那个。

clauses.quote: Name: http_response_timeout Description: The intermediary reached a configured time limit waiting for the complete response. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 504 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: false
clauses.gateway: 网关等完整的响应、到了配置的总时限时用，建议状态码 504。与 connection_read_timeout（9209-2.3.10-1，一段时间内没有新数据）不同，这里是等整个响应的时限。

clauses.quote: Name: http_protocol_error Description: The intermediary encountered an HTTP protocol error when communicating with the next hop. This error should only be used when a more specific one is not defined. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: false
clauses.gateway: 网关与下一跳通信时遇到 HTTP 协议错误、又没有更具体的类型可用时用，建议状态码 502。上游的 HTTP 代理回了无法解析的响应时适用；类型名里是 HTTP，上游是 SOCKS5 代理时的协议错误用不用它，条款没有说。

clauses.quote: Name: proxy_internal_response Description: The intermediary generated the response itself without attempting to connect to the next hop. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: The most appropriate status code for the response Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 中间方没有尝试连接下一跳、自己生成了响应时用，状态码取最合适的那个。

clauses.quote: Name: proxy_internal_error Description: The intermediary encountered an internal error unrelated to the origin. Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 500 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 中间方遇到与源站无关的内部错误时用，建议状态码 500。2.1.1 节把它列为没有合适的具体类型时可用的泛指类型之一。

clauses.quote: Name: proxy_loop_detected Description: The intermediary tried to forward the request to itself, or a loop has been detected using different means (e.g., [RFC8586]). Extra Parameters: None Recommended HTTP Status Code: 502 Response Only Generated by Intermediaries: true
clauses.gateway: 中间方发现请求要转给自己、或者用别的办法发现了环路时用，建议状态码 502。入口发现目标就是自己的监听地址时适用。

clauses.quote: One of the primary security concerns when using Proxy-Status is leaking information that might aid an attacker. For example, information about the intermediary's configuration and backend topology can be exposed, allowing attackers to directly target backend services that are not prepared for high traffic volume or malformed inputs. Some information might only be suitable to reveal to authorized parties.
clauses.gateway: Proxy-Status 会泄露中间方的配置和后端拓扑。对网关来说，上游代理的地址、数量、健康状态都属于这类信息。原文只说有些信息可能只适合给有权限的一方看（might），没有禁止；入口对没通过认证的请求（407）不带这些细节，是可以做的设计决定，不是条款要求。

clauses.quote: As a result, care needs to be taken when deciding to generate a Proxy-Status field and what information to include in it. Note that intermediaries are not required to generate a Proxy-Status field in any response and can conditionally generate them based upon request attributes (e.g., authentication tokens, IP address).
clauses.gateway: 生成不生成、放什么都要权衡；可以按请求的属性（认证、来源地址）有条件地生成。入口可以只对通过认证的调用方给出详细的 error 和 details。

clauses.quote: Also, the field's content is not verified; an intermediary can claim certain actions (e.g., sending a request over an encrypted channel) but fail to actually do that.
clauses.gateway: 字段的内容没有任何核实手段。上游代理发来的 Proxy-Status 只是它自己的说法，网关不能拿它当证据，也不能据此判定上游的行为。
